request.name: create_stream

description.summary: Create a wl_buffer from the given handle

request.description: Create a wl_buffer corresponding to given handle. The attributes list may be used to define additional EGLStream connection data (e.g inet address/port). The server can create its EGLStream handle using the information encoded in the wl_buffer.

request.name: swap_interval

description.summary: change the swap interval of an EGLStream consumer

request.description: Set the swap interval for the consumer of the given EGLStream. The swap interval is silently clamped to the valid range on the server side.

event.name: caps
event.description: The capabilities event is sent out at wl_eglstream_display binding time. It allows the server to advertise what features it supports so clients may know what is safe to be used.

event.name: swapinterval_override
event.description: The swapinterval_override event is sent out whenever a client requests a swapinterval setting through swap_interval() and there is an override in place that will make such request to be ignored. The swapinterval_override event will provide the override value so that the client is made aware of it.
